usedFor: Financial Cents holds clients, and Google Sheets gets a row per “New Client” through “Add New Row to Sheet”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Client” in Financial Cents, then “Add New Row to Sheet” in Google Sheets
bestTemplate.why: Every new client becomes a row, so one sheet always lists your whole book.

watchOut: “Delete Client” also reaches “Add New Row to Sheet”, so a deletion adds a row instead of removing one.
